### TOPK
Collects the `k` highest values for a field, including repeated values. Shorthand for `TOP(field, k, "DESC")`, and the ES|QL aggregate analogue of PromQL `topk(k, v)`.

```esql
FROM employees
| STATS top_salaries = TOPK(salary, 3)
```
